meta.name: SoilMate Learn & Play: Frontend/Backend Contract
meta.purpose: Single source of truth. If the frontend and backend disagree, this file wins. Change this file first, then change the code.
meta.scope: Learn & Play games only (5 games, hub, score screens, finale).

stack.frontend: Next.js 16 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind v4

idFormats.questionKey: string like g3-017 (g + game number + - + 3-digit number)
idFormats.choiceKey: short lowercase string, unique inside one question
idFormats.iconKey: kebab-case string, must exist in shared icon-keys.json

http.casing: camelCase for every JSON field, request and response
http.nullRules: Optional fields are omitted when empty, never sent as empty strings. A field that is documented as nullable is sent as null.

cors.note: CLIENT_ORIGIN is a single origin. Next dev server: http://localhost:3000.

http.rateLimit: 100 requests per minute per IP, then 429 with the standard error shape

flow: Frontend sends X-Player-Id if it has one.
If the header is missing or not a valid UUID v4, backend creates a player and returns the new id in the X-Player-Id response header.
Frontend saves the returned id to localStorage and sends it on every later request.
Backend updates lastSeenAt on every request.
Any attempt route returns 403 FORBIDDEN if the attempt belongs to another player.

rules.wrongAnswer: Costs 1 heart, resets streak to 0, adds the choice to that question's wrongChoiceKeys. The same question stays open.
rules.retryAfterWrong: Frontend disables every choice listed in wrongChoiceKeys for that question.
rules.zeroHearts: Attempt status becomes failed. Every later answer, skip, or complete returns 409 ATTEMPT_NOT_ACTIVE.
rules.skip: Marks the question resolved and skipped. No heart lost, no points, streak resets to 0, correct answer revealed. A skipped question is never first-try correct and never earns its collection item.
rules.score: Number of questions with firstTryCorrect = true
rules.gameBadgeEarnedWhen: score >= 4 (in any game, including the 5-question game)

masterBadge.name: Soil Expert
masterBadge.earnedWhen: all 5 game badges are earned (best result per game counts)

rules.bestResult: Progress keeps the attempt with the highest points per game
rules.attemptExpiry: Active or abandoned attempts expire 7 days after start (Mongo TTL)
rules.oneActiveAttemptPerGame: Starting a new attempt abandons any active attempt for the same player and game
rules.questionHistory: Updated only when a question is resolved (correct or skipped). Abandoned rounds do not use up questions.
rules.noRepeatsUntilAllSeen: The picker prefers never-seen questions, then least-seen, then oldest-seen, with random tie-breaks
rules.newQuestionsEveryRound: Play Again always starts a new attempt with a freshly picked set

games.title: Match the Word
games.choiceRule: Correct meaning plus 2 meanings taken from other terms in the same pool. No duplicates. Shuffled once per attempt.

games.title: Satellite or Ground?
games.choiceRule: Always these three, always in this order. Never shuffled.
games.pickerRule: 2 questions from each answer group (satellite, both, ground) per round, then the 6 are shuffled.

result.title: Great job!
result.subtitle: Satellite sees the big picture. You know the field.

games.title: Crop Superpowers
games.pickerRule: 6 different powers chosen at random out of 8. For each power, the best-ranked crop. The 6 badges on the score screen are therefore always different.

powers.label: Adds organic matter to the soil

games.title: Fix the Field
games.onCorrectVisual: Scene crossfades from illustrationKey (problem) to illustrationFixedKey (fixed): lush green field, worried cloud becomes a sun.

result.title: Fields fixed!
result.subtitle: You are a great field doctor

games.title: Weather and Crops
games.speechBubble: What will happen to the field?
games.onCorrectVisual: Scene plays resultAnimationKey (for example plants droop and water drops rise for Very hot days).

result.title: Weather wise!
result.subtitle: You can read the sky like a pro

fixedStrings.hintForLockedBadge: Score 4 or more to earn it
fixedStrings.hubSubtitle: Quick games that make the data easier

exitModal.text: Leave this game? Your progress in this round will be lost.

outOfHeartsModal.text: Out of hearts. Let's try again!

errorState.text: Something went wrong. Let's try again.

finale.doneSubtitle: Now you are ready to explore your land

fixedStrings.rule: Frontend keeps these in strings/en.ts. Backend only sends content that is stored per question or per game (prompts, choices, explanations, labels).

colorRules.wrong: Soft orange only. Never red, anywhere.
colorRules.correct: Light green with a check icon
colorRules.accessibility: Never use color alone. Pair every state with an icon or text.

QuestionForPlay.subtitle: string | omitted
QuestionForPlay.choices: Choice[] (final order, exactly the order the frontend must show)
QuestionForPlay.wrongChoiceKeys: string[] (only in the resume response, choices to show disabled)
QuestionForPlay.firstTryCorrect: boolean (only in the resume response; pending backend change, optional for the client)

AttemptState.total: integer (5 for match-the-word, 6 for the others)

games.title: string
games.questionsSeen: integer 0..poolSize (how many distinct questions this player has resolved)

endpoints.behavior: Abandons any active attempt for this player and game, runs the picker, creates a new attempt.
endpoints.response201: AttemptState (status active, hearts 3, streak 0, points 0). Questions never contain the correct answer or the explanation.

endpoints.behavior: Resume after a page refresh. Same questions, same order, same choices as when started.
endpoints.response200: AttemptState plus per-question resolved, wrongChoiceKeys and firstTryCorrect (firstTryCorrect: PENDING backend change, see BACKEND_CHANGES.md; the client treats it as optional)

response200.correctChoiceKey: string, ONLY when correct is true
response200.explanation: string, ONLY when correct is true
response200.firstTry: boolean, true when this correct answer earned points
response200.collectionItem: CollectionItem | omitted (only when firstTry is true and the game has a collection)
response200.illustrationFixedKey: string, Fix the Field only, ONLY when correct is true
response200.resultAnimationKey: string, Weather and Crops only, ONLY when correct is true

notes: A wrong answer returns 200 with correct = false. It is not an HTTP error.
A wrong answer never reveals the correct answer or the explanation.
choiceKey must belong to that question's choices in this attempt, otherwise 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

endpoints.allowedWhen: Every question is resolved and status is active

response200.collection: CollectionItem[] (exactly collectionSize items, in question order). Empty array for satellite-or-ground.
response200.recap: array of { label, iconKey } | omitted (only for satellite-or-ground)
response200.nextGame: { slug, title } | null (null only for weather-and-crops)

finale.totalPoints: integer (sum of best points across the 5 games)

notes: Calling complete twice returns the same result (idempotent). The second call does not add points again.
A failed attempt cannot be completed. The frontend shows OutOfHeartsModal instead.

endpoints.behavior: Deletes this player's attempts, progress, and question history. Keeps the player id.

leakPrevention.mongooseRule: correctChoiceKey has select: false on the Question schema
leakPrevention.frontendRule: No question text, choice, or answer is ever bundled in the client. Everything comes from the API.

prefixes.ui-: interface icons (close, heart, star, flame, leaf, check, lock, arrow-right, refresh, home, map, trophy, crown, speaker, game-controller, hamburger, satellite, sparkles, medal)
prefixes.badge-: game badges and the master badge

iconKeys.sharedFile: icon-keys.json, listing every valid key. Backend validatePool and the frontend dev check both read it.
iconKeys.fallback: If the frontend has no asset for a key, it shows a generic game icon and logs a warning in dev. It never crashes.

game1Pool.meaning: How green and healthy plants are
Water that leaves the soil and plants into the air
When soil is wetter or drier than usual
Chance of freezing cold that can harm plants
Water coming in (rain) versus water going out (heat and plants)
When wind or rain washes the soil away

questionDocument.subtitle: string, optional
questionDocument.choices: Choice[] (3 for games 2 to 5, 1 for game 1 which stores only the correct meaning)
questionDocument.collectionItem: { key, label, iconKey } for games 1, 3, 4, 5. Omitted for game 2.
questionDocument.nasaTag: optional, one of MODIS/Landsat, SMAP, GPM, NASA POWER

validatePoolMustPass: Games 2 to 5 have exactly 30 active questions each
Every correctChoiceKey exists in its question's choices
Games 2 to 5: exactly 3 choices, and no wrong choice label equals the correct label
Game 2 has 10 questions per answer group
Game 3 has all 8 powers, each with at least 3 crops

attemptDocumentFieldsBackendMustStore: questions[] with questionId, position, choices (final order), wrongChoiceKeys[], wrongCount, firstTryCorrect, skipped, resolved, resolvedAt

routesFrontend./learn/:slug: Play screen. Unknown slug redirects to /learn.
routesFrontend./learn/:slug/result: Score screen. Without a completed result in state, redirect to /learn/:slug.

navBar.pipeline: 5 circles, one per game, in position order

versioning.rule: Any change to a field name, an enum value, an endpoint, or a rule needs a bump of meta.version and a note below.

changelog.note: Initial contract. 5 games, Game 1 pool of 6 (5 per round), Games 2 to 5 pools of 30 (6 per round).
Frontend is Next.js. Documented illustrationFixedKey and resultAnimationKey in the answer response (already sent by the backend). Proposed firstTryCorrect on the resume response (pending).
